For a hotel conversion in the **Caribbean or Latin America**, the best affiliation-flexibility candidates depend chiefly on the property’s positioning. The following should be in the owner’s initial consideration set.

| Positioning | Brands worth considering | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| **Luxury resort / iconic independent hotel** | **The Luxury Collection** by Marriott; **LXR Hotels & Resorts** by Hilton; **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**; **Vignette Collection** by IHG; **Emblems Collection** by Accor; **Registry Collection Hotels** by Wyndham | Preserve a distinctive identity while accessing a major loyalty and distribution system. Expect rigorous luxury-service requirements and potentially significant PIP obligations. |
| **Upper-upscale boutique or full-service conversion** | **Autograph Collection** by Marriott; **Curio Collection by Hilton**; **MGallery Collection** by Accor | Probably the strongest mainstream shortlist for distinctive city hotels, historic properties and destination resorts. Marriott and Hilton have meaningful conversion experience in CALA. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Upscale hotel seeking lighter standards** | **Tribute Portfolio** by Marriott; **Tapestry Collection by Hilton**; **JdV by Hyatt**; **Handwritten Collection** by Accor; **Trademark Collection by Wyndham** | Generally better suited to owners seeking local identity, variable F&B and amenity programs, and a less elaborate luxury operating model. Hilton specifically describes Tapestry and Curio as flexible, conversion-oriented frameworks. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Independent luxury with maximum identity retention** | **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**, **The Leading Hotels of the World**, **Design Hotels** | Membership-style affiliations may provide greater operating and branding freedom than a conventional franchise. Preferred and LHW are especially relevant for established destination resorts; Design Hotels can provide Marriott Bonvoy access for participating members. ([join.preferredhotels.com](https://join.preferredhotels.com/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Smaller or more cost-sensitive upscale conversion** | **Ascend Hotel Collection**, **BW Premier Collection**, **BW Signature Collection**, selected **WorldHotels** collections | Worth testing where capex control and flexible standards outweigh the need for the strongest luxury loyalty contribution. Ascend and BWH explicitly emphasize independent identity and flexible conversion positioning. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCUMJCKAM4XNGDBGYQ36NVQN55WE?utm_source=openai)) |

### Particularly relevant regional options

- **Hilton Curio and Tapestry:** Proven conversion activity in Puerto Rico, Curaçao, Galápagos, Colombia, Chile, Paraguay and Brazil, making them practical regional benchmarks rather than merely theoretical options. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/uploads/2025/05/Hiltons-2024-Americas-Development-Awards-Winners.pdf?utm_source=openai))
- **Marriott’s three collections:** Luxury Collection, Autograph and Tribute provide clear segmentation and Bonvoy access; Marriott also permits these brands for qualifying all-inclusive resorts. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands?utm_source=openai))
- **IHG Vignette Collection:** A credible luxury-conversion alternative, already represented in Lima, with additional CALA development planned. It allows the hotel name, look and identity to remain prominent. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai))
- **Accor MGallery and Handwritten:** Especially relevant in South America and for owners wanting franchise flexibility. Handwritten is designed specifically as a conversion-friendly soft brand with operational flexibility. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai))
- **Wyndham Registry and Trademark:** Worth considering for resort and all-inclusive assets, particularly in Mexico and the Caribbean. Registry is positioned as an upper-upscale soft brand, while Trademark covers a broader upscale conversion range. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/upscale-lifestyle-hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai))
- **Hyatt Unbound:** Strong for experiential luxury resorts and landmark properties, although owners should test local distribution strength and development support market by market. Hyatt explicitly positions it around independence and individuality. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai))

### New brands to monitor

- **IHG Noted Collection**, launched in February 2026, targets upscale-to-upper-upscale conversions while retaining each hotel’s identity. However, its initial rollout is focused outside the Americas, so it is currently more of a watch-list option for CALA. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2026/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-unveils-new-premium-collection-brand-noted-collection?utm_source=openai))
- **Hilton Outset Collection** offers even wider amenity and product flexibility, but its initial development focus has been the United States and Canada. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/launch-of-outset-collection-by-hilton?utm_source=openai))
- **Series by Marriott** is highly flexible, but Marriott’s current development materials do not list CALA among its available regions, so it should not yet be treated as an actionable regional option. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/seriesbymarriott?utm_source=openai))

## Practical shortlist

For most upper-upscale CALA conversions, I would initially solicit proposals from:

1. **Autograph Collection**
2. **Curio Collection**
3. **Tribute Portfolio or Tapestry Collection**
4. **Vignette Collection**
5. **MGallery or Handwritten Collection**
6. **Unbound Collection or JdV by Hyatt**
7. **Registry or Trademark Collection**
8. **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**, as the independent-affiliation benchmark

The proposals should be compared on more than franchise fees: **PIP scope, name retention, mandatory F&B and amenity standards, owner-operated versus required-management structures, territorial protection, loyalty-program costs, centralized services, termination rights, ramp-up period and realistic net system contribution**. A “soft” brand can still be economically or operationally restrictive, so the decisive measure is the negotiated agreement—not the collection label.
